angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 3,907,617 km at 132.50 pc = 0.39 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.5470 +/- 0.0246 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 132.50 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 5.617 (5.503 to 5.731) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,907,617 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.171 (1.131 to 1.254) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4762 +/- 6.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1236429004715336576: teff_gspphot 4762.2856 K (16th-84th percentiles 4755.686-4768.151), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1236429004715336576: teff_gspphot 4762.2856 K (16th-84th percentiles 4755.686-4768.151), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/arcalis.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.007, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 131496 (pscomppars): spectral type K0, from Cannon & Pickering 1918 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1918AnHar..91....1C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 131496 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.25 dex, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 131496 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.99123, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 131496 (pscomppars): age 2.7 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 131496 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.48 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
